entries.content: export default JSON.parse("{\"schema\":\"ai-brain-source-note/1.0\",\"domain\":\"worldbuilding\",\"capabilities\":[\"alignment\",\"canon\",\"character\",\"class\",\"galaxy\",\"layer\",\"map\",\"npc\",\"paint\",\"planet\",\"quest\",\"rules\",\"settlement\",\"simulation\",\"spell\",\"world\"],\"provenance\":{\"sourceGroup\":\"active-session-runtime-b\",\"sourceType\":\"provided-project-material\",\"archiveHash\":\"164324aff6604b21\"},\"title\":\"readme.md\",\"content\":\"# UniversalSimulator\\n\\nUniversalSimulator is the campaign-facing successor to WorldBuilder + LifeSimulation. It combines world, galaxy, population, location, NPC, dialogue, faction, quest, and painterly-map tools with the Universal Covenant Engine.\\n\\n## Campaign scope\\n\\nThe simulator supports only the campaign eras the setting is intended to play:\\n\\n- Era 3 \u2014 Medieval\\n- Era 4 \u2014 Renaissance / Early Modern\\n- Era 5 \u2014 Industrial / Steam\\n- Era 6 \u2014 Electrified / Modern\\n- Era 7 \u2014 Digital / Atomic\\n- Era 8 \u2014 Planetary / Orbital\\n- Era 9 \u2014 Interplanetary\\n- Era 10 \u2014 Spacefaring / Interstellar\\n\\nPlanetary formation, geography, climate, orbital mechanics, and deep history remain available as world-building tools. Population, settlement, NPC, technology, reaction, and campaign-era generation never operate below Medieval. Imported older projects are normalized to this range.\\n\\n## Start the application\\n\\n1. Extract the archive.\\n2. Serve the `UniversalSimulator` folder with a static web server. For example, run `python -m http.server 8000` from the folder.\\n3. Open `http://localhost:8000/`.\\n\\nOpening `index.html` directly still exposes the built-in runtime rules index, but a web server is recommended so the nine full JSON rule files and ZIP/DOCX imports can load reliably.\\n\\n## Universal Covenant Engine integration\\n\\nThe canonical JSON files live in `json/universal_system/`:\\n\\n1. `universal_classes.json`\\n2. `universal_alignments.json`\\n3. `universal_pantheon.json`\\n4. `universal_races.json`\\n5. `universal_time_conversion.json`\\n6. `universal_how_to_play.json`\\n7. `universal_5e_spells.json`\\n8. `universal_ichor.json`\\n9. `universal_factions_and_quest_hooks.json`\\n\\nNPC generation can create unclassed civilians or classed characters using the 22-class roster and all 81 alignment profiles. Generated profiles include Covenant Engine level, HP, proficiency, Guard, Stress, Composure, Resolve, Ichor, deity/covenant fields, and stable references to the full rule data.\\n\\n## Compatibility\\n\\nOlder LifeSimulation v5 state and packages remain importable. The legacy JavaScript namespace and some folder names remain only to avoid breaking existing bridges, imports, saved projects, and asset paths. All user-facing product names, new schemas, new saves, and new exports use UniversalSimulator.\\n\\nThe app uses \u201cDM\u201d throughout new Universal-facing content.\\n\"}");

Original ZIPs and DOCX files are not copied into the package. The source versions were reconciled around the latest setting-agnostic painterly specification.\\n\\n- **WorldBuilder Setting-Agnostic Complete Edition** \u2014 shared shell, continent/globe editor, weather, celestial, galaxy, lore, upload, export and Superbot foundation.\\n- **WorldBuilder Unified Galaxy + LifeSimulation** \u2014 six-page organization, upload routing, asset-library and export patterns.\\n- **WorldBuilder Galaxy Deep Editor** \u2014 deep-sky, planet, orbit, ring, comet, asteroid, constellation, nebula and black-hole editing patterns.\\n- **WorldBuilder Deep Biome to Settlement Builder** \u2014 canonical biome and settlement-template logic.\\n- **WorldBuilder Painterly Interactive Settlements v1.1.0** \u2014 native painterly settlement/interior scenes, hotspots, paths, effects and scheduled token movement.\\n- **LifeSimulation Integrated Front-Facing v5.1.0** \u2014 NPC/location/race/token/dialogue/simulation implementation.\\n- **WorldBuilder Complete Race Token Tree v2.0.0** \u2014 23 categories, 14 identities and 3,486 static token filename entries.\\n- **Consolidated Painterly Specification** \u2014 source precedence, product boundaries, no programmed 3D settlements, front-facing authoring and QA invariants.\\n\"}");

Legacy lowercase asset paths and JavaScript aliases remain for compatibility only.\\n\\nThe Universal Covenant Engine is integrated from nine canonical JSON files in `json/universal_system/`. A compact browser runtime index provides the 22 classes, 81 alignment profiles, 22 pantheon entries, six player-safe faction seeds, and 30 player-safe quest hooks without duplicating the full rule texts.\\n\\nCampaign generation is restricted to Era 3 (Medieval) through Era 10 (Spacefaring / Interstellar). Planetary geology, climate, orbits, and deep-world history are not campaign-era population generation and remain available.\\n\"}");
